summary: Registered a sourced, reproducible finding about the snapshot/authority-transition path in hashicorp/raft c0dc6a0b. Two Behaviors: installSnapshot (raft.go 1814-1953) sets lastApplied and lastSnapshot but never setLastLog nor invalidates a pre-existing entry at the snapshot index; raftState.getLastEntry (state.go 167-174) resolves the index tie in favour of the log term whenever lastLogIndex >= lastSnapshotIndex. Consequence: after a successful InstallSnapshot for (L,T), a follower that already held an earlier-term entry at L advertises term != T for L and rejects the leader's next AppendEntries with PrevLogEntry=L/PrevLogTerm=T (raft.go 1475-1500), Success=false with NoRetryBackoff=true. Investigation @q-snapshot-boundary plus a registered experiment (assurance_generated_test.go, in-package, inmem transport, defect case vs control) are included; a driver harness was built and exercised in a scratch copy, where the defect case returned success=false and the control success=true. The interpretation is conclusion=conditional, defect_claim=unresolved because that local run is construction feedback rather than a retained receipt; the leader-side repeated-snapshot cycle is registered as an open gap instead of being asserted. Structural validation of the draft bytes returned valid=true.
